title: agent-dispatch configuration
description: Schema for agent-dispatch TOML configuration. Contains no credentials by design: the GitHub wrapper owns its token and the runtime owns model-provider auth.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Discovery poll interval. Polling (no webhook server) keeps the VM free of inbound endpoints.

max_concurrent_tasks.description: MVP default is 1. Keeps at most one writer per worktree and bounds model cost.

run_timeout_seconds.description: Hard wall-clock cap for a single agent run. A hung run is killed and bounded-retried.

max_attempts.description: Bounded retries before a task is marked failed with a human recovery path.

worktree_root.description: Root for orchestrator-owned worktrees. The user's normal checkout is never modified.

state_db.description: SQLite state database path. MUST live outside target repositories.

run_log_dir.description: Directory for raw NDJSON run logs. MUST live outside every target repository and worktree, otherwise a log can be swept into a commit by 'git add -A' and would pollute the PR with a raw agent transcript.

run_log_keep.description: Bounded retention for run logs (count-based pruning).

lock_file.description: Single-process lock; prevents two workers running at once.

commandcode_path.description: Path to the runtime binary. Resolved via PATH when omitted.

command.description: Approved GitHub wrapper command. Deliberately configurable so the historical wrapper name is not hardcoded into the reusable package.

credential_helper.description: Approved Git credential helper, e.g. '!/path/to/wrapper auth git-credential'. MUST be applied AFTER credential_helper_reset, because credential.helper is multi-valued and a bare -c override appends instead of replacing. The reset entry is what prevents an ambient unapproved helper from being queried first.

credential_helper_reset.description: Empty value that RESETS the inherited credential.helper list before the approved helper is added (per gitcredentials). Must remain empty: it is not a no-op. Set via -c for orchestrator commands and written into the worktree's repo-local config so agent-issued Git inherits the same order.

fail_fast_on_denied_repo.description: Refuse to proceed when a configured repository is absent from the credential's permitted set, rather than retrying.

trigger.description: Issue label expressing dispatch intent. Stays for the whole active lifetime; it is not a local status mirror.

review_handoff.description: PR label that initiates exactly ONE consolidated follow-up round on the existing session. Review comments alone never start an agent.

repos.description: Allowlist of repositories. Anything not listed here is refused. Keys are 'owner/name'.

path.description: Absolute path to the local clone used as the worktree source.

base_branch.description: Base branch for task branches, fetched fresh before worktree creation.

agents_file.description: Repo-relative instructions file the agent should read before implementing.

driver.description: Runtime adapter. Only 'commandcode' is implemented in the MVP (pinned per task; adding a driver means adding one adapter module, not rewriting queue/worktree/review logic).

model.description: Pinned model id, e.g. 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash'. Unsupported ids are a startup error; the worker never silently substitutes another paid model. Changing this affects new tasks only.

permission_mode.description: Broad allow-all grant for unattended headless mutation. A deliberate trust choice on this personal VM, NOT a sandbox.

permission_flag.description: Literal flag appended by the driver. '--yolo' is the only flag verified on VM v1.64.0 to unlock headless writes; '--permission-mode yolo' and '--tools-all' were both observed BLOCKED, and the grant does not persist across --session resume, so it is re-passed every invocation.

max_turns.description: Turn cap per invocation. A cap hit exits with code 8 and is treated as a bounded failure, not success.
